notes: The CP criterion 'while they are at the registered establishment' is a temporal qualifier that applies to both traceability and integrity requirements. The validated rule-set relation indicates that 4-7B(b) and 4-8 support the same criterion, but they impose distinct obligations (traceability vs integrity). Therefore, both must be satisfied, justifying an ALL combination.

Candidate rules2021:4-7B is a general tracing requirement that is specialized by 4-7B(b). Only 4-7B(b) is used as a basis for A1 because it directly matches the temporal scope of the CP. The general provision is not separately required.
Candidates with contract_eligible=false were not used as legal bases, even if they contained relevant text, per the hard rule.
